description: Save something you wrote — a newsletter draft, a volunteer list, meeting notes — onto a ticket as a Markdown (.md), text (.txt) or CSV (.csv) file. Only those kinds: a photo or PDF shown to you in chat cannot be passed on as bytes, and for those the answer is the ticket's link so the person can add the file in the app.

filename.description: The file name with its extension: .md, .txt or .csv

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.

name: attach_file
title: Attach a file you wrote
